provenance_notes: Downloaded from the Kaggle 'Retail Data Analytics' listing uploaded by Manjeet Singh.
This is the same dataset distributed for the Walmart Recruiting - Store Sales Forecasting competition, re-hosted under CC0.
Original filenames ('Features data set.csv', 'sales data-set.csv', 'stores data-set.csv') are renamed to canonical names (features.csv, train.csv, stores.csv) on ingestion into data/raw/.
No rows, columns, or values are synthesized, substituted, or fabricated. Only the approved three source files are used.
MarkDown1-5 fields are largely absent prior to Nov 2011 (promotions were not tracked before that date); missing values are treated as 'no markdown active', not as data-quality defects.
